name: Herbarium Sheet
description: The plants in flower or fruit around the panel right now, as a herbarium sheet: a few pressed specimens mounted on paper with strips of tape, a small label under each, a printed institutional label and a stamp. From iNaturalist's research-grade plant records near a place or by one user. The records' own photographs, or AI paintings in five styles with a fal.ai key.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Source
cell_options.help: Near a place is what people have recorded around the cell's location. A user is one person's own plant observations, anywhere.

cell_options.name: user_login
cell_options.label: iNaturalist username
cell_options.help: The username whose plant observations make the sheet. Set it to your own to see what you have pressed.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: The place to look around, named on the label and the stamp. Falls back to the app-level location in Settings when empty.

cell_options.name: radius_km
cell_options.label: Within
cell_options.help: How far round the place to look.

cell_options.name: window
cell_options.label: Window
cell_options.help: This month is the current calendar month in any year, so the sheet is seasonal: what flowers here at this time of year. The rolling windows count back from to-day and change as records come in.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Mounted sets a few specimens side by side or in a grid, each with its label. Single plate shows the most recorded species alone, large, with the label block.

cell_options.name: count
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Specimens on the sheet, the most recorded species first. A small cell shows one whatever is set.

cell_options.name: pictures
cell_options.label: Pictures
cell_options.help: Photographs cost nothing: each species' iNaturalist photo in a soft oval, credited to its photographer. AI paintings paint each species once, from that photo, in the style below, at about US$0.04 a species; the sheet shows the photograph until each painting lands. Needs a fal.ai key in this widget's settings or under Settings.

cell_options.name: style
cell_options.label: Style
cell_options.help: The style every painting is made in. Each style is painted once per species and kept. The cyanotype is a white silhouette on Prussian blue paper, so the picture area goes blue.

cell_options.name: model
cell_options.label: Model
cell_options.help: All on fal.ai, all painting from a photo of the species. Nano Banana is faithful and cheap; Nano Banana Pro follows an unusual instruction better and draws finer detail; FLUX.1 Kontext Pro adheres most strongly to a style; GPT Image 2 is a good likeness with a narrower range; Seedream 4 is the budget one. Each model keeps its own paintings, so switching never throws any away.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: What the panel can show. Paintings are converted and contrast-stretched to match; photographs are shown in grey; on black and white the type is thickened.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: The first word on the label block. Blank is HERBARIUM.

cell_options.name: credits
cell_options.label: Credits at the foot
cell_options.help: The photographers, their licences and the painter, in small type at the foot of the sheet. Photographs are also credited on the iNaturalist record.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widget can paint each species from its own photograph, at about US$0.04 a painting, once per species and style. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run. Without one the widget shows photographs.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices (US$2 is about fifty Nano Banana paintings). 0 is no limit. Paintings are kept, so a species in a style only costs once; after a few weeks most of what flowers is already painted.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50). A panel's own render starts what its page needs, within the daily number.
